sloka: वानराणाम् महत् सैन्यम् सुग्रीवे प्रीतिमान् अभूत् ।पादयोः पतितम् मूर्ध्ना तम् उत्थाप्य हरीश्वरम् ॥४-३८-१८॥
transliteration: vānarāṇām mahat sainyam sugrīve prītimān abhūt ।pādayoḥ patitam mūrdhnā tam utthāpya harīśvaram ॥4-38-18॥

translations.english: Sugriva touched Rama's feet, bending his head down, and Rama lifted him up and embraced him with love and great regard.
